Alex (infra-ops): Heads up — received 6 H100s from NexaSupply, 2 units show DOA on power-up. Rack power OK, no physical damage noted. Serial samples below.
Maria (logistics): ack. can you drop the serials and AWB? need for customs/claims.
Alex (infra-ops): AWB: 1Z999AA10123456784. Skus/serials:
```
H100-XL | SN: HX100-00123 | OK
H100-XL | SN: HX100-00124 | DOA
H100-XL | SN: HX100-00125 | OK
H100-XL | SN: HX100-00126 | DOA
H100-XL | SN: HX100-00127 | OK
H100-XL | SN: HX100-00128 | OK
```
Jonathan (procurement): Diane, what's your proposed flow for swap/replacement? lead time? can we get loaners while replacements ship?
Diane - NexaSupply: Hi all — sorry about that. We can either: 1) send replacements from our EU buffer (ETA 7–10 business days) or 2) escalate to overnight air (ETA 2 business days) at cost. We also offer temporary loaners for critical clusters while RMA processes (no extra charge for 7 days).
Maria (logistics): Are replacements going to be consolidated on a single AWB (preferred) or split shipments? customs in DE are picky recently.
Diane - NexaSupply: We can consolidate to one AWB, but we need your approval to amend the original invoice and HS code to avoid reclassification delay. Also need proof of power-on DOA logs for each DOA unit.
Alex (infra-ops): DOA logs attached in thread — short serial console dump and power current readouts. Let me know if you need additional tests.
RMA Bot: New RMA ticket created: RMA-2026-1457. Please include this number on all paperwork and AWB annotations.
Jonathan (procurement): For the invoice amendment — can NexaSupply absorb customs brokerage fee if we consolidate? those fees hit our dev budget hard.
Diane - NexaSupply: We can credit brokerage up to $250 per shipment if replacements shipped consolidated. If you request overnight air, brokerage credit reduced (carrier premium). Also, we'll waive the initial RMA processing fee for this batch.
Maria (logistics): OK please consolidate and apply brokerage credit. Also confirm whether the loaners require local forwarder paperwork or if NexaSupply handles crossdock release.
Diane - NexaSupply: We'll handle crossdock release and send customs docs. Loaners: we'll ship on loaner PO, you return within 7 days using our prepaid label. If extended, we'll invoice daily prorated loaner fee.
Alex (infra-ops): Sounds good. One more ask — can we get serials of the replacements before shipping? want to update our asset inventory/monitoring.
Diane - NexaSupply: Yes, will provide replacement SKUs+serials once allocated from buffer. ETA for allocation confirmation: 24 hours.
Jonathan (procurement): Great. I’ll approve consolidation and cost credit. Please include RMA-2026-1457 on all docs. Any estimated final ETA if consolidated sea/air mix happens?
Diane - NexaSupply: If consolidated and surface + air-mix: ETA 4–6 business days. If full air: 2 business days. We’ll confirm after allocation.
Maria (logistics): Noted. I’ll prepare to receive consolidated AWB and send facility clearance contact. thx.
Alex (infra-ops): Thanks — holding cluster in degraded mode until replacements/loaners arrive. keep me posted.
Diane - NexaSupply: Will update here within 24h with allocation and serials. Apologies again — we’ll prioritize this RMA.
